text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Picture crowds as points: those with the right average lie on a line. The tilted crowd is the foot of the perpendicular. Any other fix pays the tilt's cost plus an extra, as in Pythagoras. And nothing moves: the tilted crowd lives only where the model's crowd was.
